   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 24, 2026 - Aug 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Laura Friedman_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "This newly made over health app, that the phone promotes as essential, requires at least two paid subscriptions, of dubious value, to function. Samsung is trying to be as morally bankrupt as Apple. Welcome to the world of being lied to so they can take your money. ## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Pia Kivelä_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "Ever since the last update, the app has been extremely slow, glitchy and unrealiable. I've managed to live with it until now. For the past few days, my data has not synced to my phone at all. I keep getting "couldn't sync data" message. I've cleared all the caches, unpaired the device and restarted both devices several times. Nothing helps. Fix this fast!"
            2. _George Ristic_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "Latest update turned the app into unusable UI mess. I uninstalled the app and decided never to buy Galaxy watch or phone ever again. Switching to Garmin for proper fitness tracking rather than having the "fitness" hardware and software developed by the team of overweight people who never ran more than 100m in their life. Goodbye Samsung, you deserve to be devoured by Chinese phone manufacturers."
            3. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
